purpose: Clean-room pattern records harvested from Catmode, Get Fridge, and StickerOS. These records preserve portable interaction contracts without importing donor-specific code, personal data, demo claims, or unsafe incentives.
evidenceRelationship: implemented prototypes illustrate these patterns; they do not validate general effectiveness

sources.scope: room prescription, digital delivery, printable prescription, and seven-day observation protocol
ingredient intake, bounded meal selection, Cook Mode, recovery reveal, completion, and saved recipes
reactive sticker data model, local context ranking, shared storage, and cross-surface extensions

patterns.name: Behavioral Loop Prescription
patterns.thesis: Represent a recurring behavior as a sequence of needs and design a route that lets the full sequence complete without repeatedly falling into the harmful default path.
observedImplementation: watch to hide to scratch to pounce to recover sequence
room diagnosis framed as a missing loop
risks: treating one observed sequence as universal
designing for the observer instead of the affected subject

patterns.name: Route Before Object
patterns.thesis: Diagnose the missing connection between useful elements before recommending another object, feature, purchase, or screen.
observedImplementation: existing perch, hide, scratcher, couch, and toy treated as disconnected nodes
the intervention connects nodes before adding inventory
risks: using minimalism to deny necessary resources

patterns.name: Subject-Decides-Outcome
patterns.thesis: The being most affected by an intervention determines whether it works through observable use, refusal, friction, or recovery rather than designer confidence alone.
observedImplementation: explicit statement that the cat decides whether the room works

patterns.name: Medium-Translated Intervention
patterns.thesis: Express one intervention through distinct media designed for distinct jobs: a navigable screen for understanding, a formal document for preservation, and a field sheet for observation.
risks: visual parity mistaken for functional equivalence

patterns.name: Use-What-You-Have Trial
patterns.thesis: Test the logic of an intervention with reversible existing materials before turning uncertainty into a purchase recommendation.
observedImplementation: budget mode labeled use what you have
buy nothing until the route works
requiredControls: permission to conclude that the idea failed
risks: treating a temporary workaround as a permanent solution

patterns.name: Appliance Mode
patterns.thesis: Temporarily turn a general-purpose screen into one task appliance with one visible step, stable controls, nearby recovery, and no unrelated feed pressure.
observedImplementation: one large instruction at a time
ingredients available through a compact drawer

patterns.name: Available-Materials Compiler
patterns.thesis: Compile a useful next action from the materials already present rather than beginning with an idealized plan that requires new acquisition.

patterns.name: Choice Surrender Control
patterns.thesis: Let the person explicitly delegate one bounded decision when choosing is the burden, while keeping the chosen option inspectable and reversible.
observedImplementation: Surprise me selects from the already visible bounded meal set
the user can return and choose another option

patterns.name: Quiet Satisficing Completion
patterns.thesis: Acknowledge that the necessary thing happened without demanding celebration, optimization, productivity momentum, or a positive emotional performance.
observedImplementation: simple yes, maybe, or no reflection
risks: using low-pressure language to conceal poor outcomes

patterns.name: Evidence-by-Use Archive
patterns.thesis: Let completed use, not generated possibility, determine what earns a durable place in the personal archive.
observedImplementation: recipes can be saved after selection and use
saved copy says when something works, keep it here
make-again feedback separates possibility from lived utility
risks: mistaking one use for stable preference

patterns.name: Ambient State Object
patterns.thesis: Represent a small changing state as a sendable object that can sit inside ordinary conversation instead of requiring a dashboard or explanatory paragraph.

patterns.name: Context Without Confession
patterns.evidence: product hypothesis implemented as sample objects
patterns.thesis: Allow a person to communicate operational context through a chosen artifact without requiring emotional explanation, diagnosis, or intimate disclosure.
observedImplementation: energy, focus, ETA, and availability communicated as stickers
user-selected object rather than inferred message
risks: recipient treating status as surveillance data

patterns.name: Cross-Surface Expressive Continuity
patterns.thesis: Keep one user-owned expressive object coherent across its library, editor, keyboard, message surface, and share extension without rebuilding identity in every context.

patterns.name: Local Context Suggestion
patterns.thesis: Rank user-authored expressive objects against small local context signals without uploading the conversation, generating content, or claiming to know the person.
observedImplementation: deterministic scoring for time, battery, activity status, favorites, and usage

strengthenedExistingPatterns.name: Something Feels Off? Recovery Reveal
strengthenedExistingPatterns.reason: The source contains an implemented optional mid-task repair hatch with problem-to-fix guidance. No duplicate record is created.

strengthenedExistingPatterns.name: Bounded Machine Metaphor
strengthenedExistingPatterns.donorEvidence: Get Fridge Cook Mode and Catmode Room Prescription
strengthenedExistingPatterns.reason: Both donors demonstrate a phone temporarily behaving like a bounded appliance or field instrument.

strengthenedExistingPatterns.name: Format Carries Meaning
strengthenedExistingPatterns.donorEvidence: Catmode digital prescription, formal PDF, and field log
strengthenedExistingPatterns.reason: The source shows that format changes the operational contract rather than merely restyling identical content.

quarantine: copying donor-specific personal details as reusable sample data
presenting animal behavior interpretation as veterinary diagnosis or proven causality
delaying necessary purchases or safety equipment in the name of using what is available
unsafe generated cooking substitutions, allergy assumptions, or unverified food-safety guidance
daily-use paywalls that exploit basic care needs
automatic sending of status, availability, energy, battery, location, or activity data
requiring full-access keyboard permissions for basic operation
inferring mood, personality, diagnosis, or relationship intent from a selected sticker
presenting a prototype as evidence that a pattern is generally effective
